title: Edgar Mitchell on the Moon landing imagery

tellings.quote: "James, it wouldn't surprise me." me. He goes, "We had hustleblot cameras with no viewfinders, gardening gloves on."

plain: Edgar Mitchell, an astronaut who walked on the Moon in 1971, is said to have answered a question about the Moon landing pictures with "James, it wouldn't surprise me," adding that the astronauts used Hasselblad cameras, a make of film camera, with no viewfinders while wearing gardening gloves. The documentary filmmaker James Fox tells this, repeating what Mitchell said to him. Fox brings it up because it suggests that even an astronaut thought some of the famous pictures might not have been taken the way the public believes.
